## Stop doing the work.
Start directing agents.

Pylon investigates every issue before your team opens it. Direct agents to dig deeper, check other systems, and handle follow-up work while your team focuses on judgment.

## Turn raw customer data into usable intelligence.

Build support, account, and product intelligence across conversations, CRM, product usage, logs, and code, then make it available via MCP to your agents and team.

![Cognition](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a2c6d7ab6674379553c0824/6a56d7a9b52dcd8eddc73ed3_Cognition_AI.png)
